description: Retrieves all comments for a Jira issue. Returns comment author, content, timestamps, and visibility settings. Supports pagination for issues with many comments.

issueKey.description: Issue key to get comments for (e.g., PROJECT-123)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of comments to return (default: 50)

orderBy.description: Sort order for comments: "created" (oldest first), "-created" (newest first)

startAt.description: Index of first comment to return (for pagination)

name: jira_get_comments
